scope: Bottom-up compact decoder/WL-driver and complete column-split macro width reduction

source.sizing_and_timing: Frozen candidate-2 source decks; unchanged models, sizing/timing tables and simulation RC

checks: Preserve every source MOS, model, length, net and summed physical finger width; compare actual active/poly gate count and area
Compare every layer of default dense controller gates with the preceding source; compact=True alone changes geometry
Refold 128/256/512-column WL NAND2s from 4/8/16 to 3/6/12 fingers per MOS; verify all frozen driver classes
Join facing same-body VSS taps at eight-row decoder band boundaries; retain every row, predecode net and WL driver
Reduce minimum decoder-to-array well clearance from 400 to 225 nm; retain source-owned controller, registers, replica, latch and macro pins
Resolve controller placement to its 100 nm routing grid before adding a five-track (500 nm) escape margin
Require smaller actual complete-macro GDS width and area than the immediately preceding baseline at all five sizes
Calibre DRC zero and strict LVS CORRECT on the decoder component and all complete macros
Distributed R+C+CC extraction on complete 32/64/128 macros; explicitly no extraction at 256/512
Bind physical receipts to source, GDS, generator, tool and PDK rule hashes; preserve failed attempts and older evidence
waveform_validation: not run; physical compaction does not establish waveform correctness or release qualification

rectangular_smoke.intent: A single decoder band with wide WL drivers must pass without relying on neighbouring tap bridges
